description: Search listings on the marketplace. Results never include seller contacts. Show a listing only with the photos that search_adverts or get_advert returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources. If it has no photo, show no image. To show the user photos, call show_listings with the advert_ids: its cards display the listings' own photos. New developments (projects that developers sell off-plan or newly built) are a separate catalog: use search_new_buildings for them.
